core_obligations: Compare the two S-endomorphisms through their effect on global sections.

proof_roadmap.step: Fully faithful recognition on the affine side.

difficulty_reason: For a scheme X, if the canonical morphism X -> Spec Gamma(X, O_X) (whose existence is Schemes, lemma morphism-into-affine) admits a retraction, then X is affine. The retained proof is written: denote f : X -> S and s : S -> X with s f = id_X; composing f s f = f, the two endomorphisms f s and id_S of the affine scheme S induce the same map on global sections (since f is an isomorphism on global sections by construction of S), and the fully faithfulness of Gamma on affines (the contravariant equivalence between affine schemes and rings, invoked through the uniqueness clause of the same Schemes lemma) forces f s = id_S; hence f is an isomorphism and X is affine. Retained author proof at lines 23554-23563.
